## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION: Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; conflicting signals — broad sector participation but concentration in a few tech ramp-ups and material divergences among mega-cap techs. Confirmations: (1) Strong sector breadth (10/11) and (2) Major-cap divergence + narrow top-performer concentration.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Financials lead: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%); Financials breadth: 16/20 positive. Technology strength driven by semi cycle: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%); Technology breadth: 18/24 positive. Consumer Staples showing steady support: KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +7.13%); Staples breadth: 12/14 positive.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weak: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%); Energy breadth: 3/10 positive. Large-cap Tech softness: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%); Communication/Internet mixed with several names BELOW TREND (META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -8.05%)) — Communication breadth: 8/10 positive but internals uneven.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%), ASML ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%), CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%); Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: IBM CORRECTION (1W: -4.42% | 1M: +26.84%), ACN CORRECTION (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +6.66%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%), PLTR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.58%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%); Weakness concentrated in large-cap software/FAAMG names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%), AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%), LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) — all ABOVE TREND and confirming semi-cycle strength; watch NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) as a short-term bounce amid 1M weakness.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: major semiconductor names ABOVE TREND (INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%)) while mega-cap software/internet names are BELOW TREND (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%)); Technology breadth: 18/24 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) with broad participation across banks and financials; V CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +0.65%) shows some rotation within the group; Financials breadth: 16/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive pockets intact: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +11.74%); Healthcare breadth: 14/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and selected Industrials/Materials exposure given broad sector participation and semi-cycle confirmation (JPM ABOVE TREND, CAT ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND), reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap Tech names showing BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT); Style: Mixed, leaning Value/Cyclical given Financials/Industrial strength but monitor narrow tech leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%). BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (semi/equipment leaders) — Technology breadth: 18/24 positive; Financials — Financials breadth: 16/20 positive. BEARISH: Energy (slightly negative) — Energy breadth: 3/10 positive; Large-cap Internet/Software internals remain at risk despite sector-level positivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA RECOVERY hold above its recent 1W pivot for broader tech stability; AAPL BELOW TREND failure to reclaim the 1M swing low would increase downside risk; INTC ABOVE TREND sustaining this week’s breakout would confirm semi-cycle leadership and capex reflation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTC (+55): Double-upgrades/AI analyst interest; price confirming (INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%)) — sentiment confirmed. AMD (+60): Meta AI pact headlines; price confirming (AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%)). NVDA (+60): Berkshire note on AI; price shows RECOVERY (NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%)) — bullish news but 1M weakness signals tactical, not wholesale, accumulation. ORCL (+55): beat/guide headline but price is BELOW TREND (ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%)) — bullish headline diverging from price (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-45): Reported unwind/manus deal; price BELOW TREND (META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -8.05%)) — sentiment confirmed. PLTR (-50): Contract scrutiny headlines; price BELOW TREND (PLTR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.58%)) — confirmed weakness. AMGN (-55): FDA/Tavneos noise (if applicable in SP100 context) — monitor if price confirms.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed leaning Value/Cyclical given Financials and Industrial participation. INTC, AMAT, LRCX showing strength (all ABOVE TREND) while AAPL and MSFT are BELOW TREND. Key risk: major-cap tech divergences and sentiment/price divergences (e.g., NVDA, ORCL) — watch for trend breaks.
